The '''Voss commandos''' were [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]], natives of the [[Voss|planet]] of the same name. The [[Commando/Legends|Commandos]] were said to have undergone disciplined training that allowed them to survive the attacks of another native [[Species/Legends|species]], a tech-savvy pre-flight species named the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]]. The Commandos operated alongside the [[Voss Mystics]], and were headquartered in the fortified [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Voss-Ka]]. [[Jenar-Sei]] commanded a squad of Voss Commandos during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
===Galactic War===
During the [[Galactic War]] between [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Voss became disputed territory as both factions sought an alliance with the [[Voss (species)|Voss]]. The Empire and Republic assisted the Voss commandos and [[Voss Mystics]] in dealing with their ancient enemies, the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]]. Some commandos disobeyed orders and ventured into the [[Nightmare Lands]], becoming corrupted. They were later eliminated by forces allied to the commandos.<ref name="Cleanse the Corrupted">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Cleanse the Corrupted|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

The commandos protected the perimeter and the inner sanctum of the [[Shrine of Healing]], a temple for Voss Mystics in training.<ref name="Bloody Pilgrimage">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]]|Bloody Pilgrimage|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

===Supporting the Republic===
In [[3640 BBY]], the Voss commando [[Abdan-Sho]] worked with the Republic [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Kelnu Velus]] and another individual to retrieve an [[Gormak experimental armor|experimental]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] used by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]].<ref name="Fishing Facade">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Fishing Facade|[[Voss]]}}</ref> After the [[Death/Legends|killing]] of his comrade, the commando [[Goren-Bo]] requested the help of a Republic-aligned individual to hunt down the [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] responsible, named [[Grellik]].<ref name="Nightmare Predator">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Nightmare Predator|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

That same year, the [[First Commando]] [[Nakar-Sel]] presided over the [[Trial of the First]], a ritualistic test against commando recruits, with a Republic team. The commando [[Nodin-Fe]] asked for the assistance of a Republic hero to find and bury the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Evuk-Nosk]], which the Gormak sought to use.<ref name="Stop the Excavation">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Stop the Excavation|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

===In league with the Empire===
At the same time, a force of Voss commandos were engaged by the Gormak at the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]], suffering casualties, but were later assisted by a Imperial individual who destroyed the Gormak and their weaponry.<ref name="Supply Raid">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|Supply Raid|[[Voss]]}}</ref> The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith lord]] known as the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] helped the commandos [[Biddeck-Va]] and [[Ono-Mi]] by eliminating several Gormak [[Chief/Legends|chieftains]], but later turned against and killed them to acquire the [[Pendant of Bone]] in their possession.<ref name="Pendant of Bone">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]]|Pendant of Bone|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

When the Shrine of Healing fell under attack by [[Gormak cannon]] fire, the commandos enlisted the assistance of an Imperial individual to destroy them.<ref name="The Gormak Problem">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|The Gormak Problem|[[Voss]]}}</ref> [[Kotal-De]] led a group of commandos with Imperial assistance to capture the Gormak [[King/Legends|King]] [[Jokull]] but was killed in the process.<ref name="The Gormak War">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|The Gormak War|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Voss commandos were first introduced in a [http://www.swtor.com/info/holonet holonet] article for the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game.
